entries.wording: Your parcel will be in good hands with Dragonfly!
entries.note: Internal label Data received: the merchant's data arrived and the parcel is still with the merchant.
Internal label Received: the merchant handed the parcel over at a Dragonfly station.

entries.wording: Your parcel is on the move!
entries.note: Internal label Hub station inbound scan.

entries.wording: Your parcel is being prepared for delivery!
entries.note: Internal label Delivery station inbound scan: the local station prepares the round. Seen in archived replies of the tracking service.
Internal label First delivery attempt / REASON; the long label says the driver could not get in or no one answered. Seen in an archived reply of the tracking service.

entries.wording: Oops, there might be a problem with the address you gave
entries.note: Internal label Incorrect address, on the day of a round; the parcel then went back to the station and was delivered later. Seen in an archived reply of the tracking service.
Internal label Returned to warehouse: the parcel went back to the local station undelivered for another day. Seen in archived replies of the tracking service.
